title: Case Reports and Case Series — Writing One Properly with CARE

hook.en: Your first publication does not need a grant, a team or a hundred patients. It can be one patient you treated, written up carefully. A good case report teaches others, spots new problems and starts your research journey. A bad one is a diary entry. The CARE checklist is the difference.
hook.ur: Aap ki pehli publication ko grant, team ya sau mareez nahi chahiye. Yeh ek mareez ho sakta hai jis ka aap ne ilaaj kiya, ehtiyat se likha hua. Achhi case report doosron ko sikhati hai, naye masail pakadti hai aur aap ke research safar ko shuru karti hai. Buri report diary ki entry hai. CARE checklist farq hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what a case report and a case series can and cannot show, follow the CARE checklist to structure one, protect patient privacy and consent, and decide when a case is worth writing.
goal.ur: End tak aap jaanenge ke case report aur case series kya dikha sakti hain aur kya nahi, CARE checklist se ek ka dhancha banayenge, mareez ki nijiyat aur razamandi mehfooz rakhenge, aur tay karenge ke case likhne ke qabil hai ya nahi.

text.en: A **case report** describes one patient in detail; a **case series** describes several patients with something in common. They cannot prove that a treatment works, because there is no comparison. But they are valuable for **unusual presentations, new or rare conditions, unexpected harms, new techniques and teaching**. The **CARE** guideline gives a standard structure: title, abstract, introduction, patient information, clinical findings, timeline, diagnostic assessment, interventions, outcomes, discussion and patient perspective.
text.ur: **Case report** ek mareez ko tafseel se bayan karti hai; **case series** kai mareezon ko jin mein kuch mushtarak ho. Yeh sabit nahi kar sakti ke ilaaj kaam karta hai, kyunke muqabla nahi. Lekin yeh **ghair mamooli presentations, naye ya nadir halat, ghair mutawaqqe nuqsan, nayi techniques aur taleem** ke liye qeemti hain. **CARE** guideline ek mayaari dhancha deti hai: title, abstract, introduction, mareez ki maloomat, clinical findings, timeline, diagnostic assessment, interventions, outcomes, discussion aur mareez ka nuqta-e-nazar.

text.en: Think of a **single postcard from a distant town**. It cannot tell you about the whole country, but it can show you something you never knew existed. Many postcards together begin to show a pattern. A case report is a postcard: vivid, honest, limited.
text.ur: **Door ke shehar se ek postcard** sochein. Yeh poore mulk ke baare mein nahi bata sakta, lekin woh dikha sakta hai jo aap ne kabhi nahi jaana tha. Bohat se postcards mil kar ek namoona dikhane lagte hain. Case report postcard hai: wazeh, imaandar, mehdood.

title.en: Writing a case report with CARE
title.ur: CARE ke saath case report likhna

steps.title: Decide why the case is worth reporting
steps.detail: Is it unusual, instructive, a new technique or an unexpected harm? If the lesson is "I treated an ordinary patient and they got better", it is probably not. || Tay karein ke case kyun likhne ke qabil hai

steps.title: Get consent and protect privacy
steps.detail: Ask the patient for written consent for publication, remove names, dates and any details that identify them, and keep the signed form. Some journals require their own consent forms. || Razamandi lein aur nijiyat mehfooz karein

steps.title: Build the timeline
steps.detail: Lay out the key events by date or day: onset, first visit, tests, each treatment change and the outcome. A timeline table makes a case readable. || Timeline banayein

steps.title: Describe findings and treatment honestly
steps.detail: Report positive and negative findings, what was tried, what did not work and what you would do differently. Include the patient's own view of the experience. || Findings aur ilaaj imaandari se bayan karein

steps.title: Write a careful discussion
steps.detail: Compare with similar published cases, state limits clearly and give one or two take-home messages. Do not claim that the treatment "cures" or "proves". || Ehtiyat se discussion likhein

question.en: A therapist treated one patient with frozen shoulder using a new technique and the patient improved. She writes "this technique cures frozen shoulder". What is the problem?
question.ur: Ek therapist ne frozen shoulder ke ek mareez ka nayi technique se ilaaj kiya aur mareez behtar hua. Woh likhti hai "yeh technique frozen shoulder theek karti hai". Masla kya hai?

text.en: There is no problem, because she observed it herself
text.ur: Koi masla nahi, kyunke us ne khud dekha

feedback.en: Observation is valuable but does not prove cause.
feedback.ur: Mushahida qeemti hai lekin wajah sabit nahi karta.

text.en: Case reports cannot be written about frozen shoulder
text.ur: Frozen shoulder par case reports nahi likhi ja sakti

feedback.en: They can; the claim is the problem.
feedback.ur: Likhi ja sakti hain; masla dawa hai.

text.en: One case without comparison cannot show that a technique cures a condition; frozen shoulder improves over time anyway
text.ur: Muqabla ke baghair ek case nahi dikha sakta ke technique bimari theek karti hai; frozen shoulder waise bhi waqt ke saath behtar hoti hai

feedback.en: Yes — natural history and chance can explain one patient's recovery.
feedback.ur: Haan — qudrati sehatyabi aur ittifaq ek mareez ki recovery ki wazahat kar sakte hain.

question.en: Before you publish a case report, what must you obtain and protect?
question.ur: Case report shaya karne se pehle aap ko kya hasil aur mehfooz karna chahiye?

text.en: The patient's written consent, and their privacy by removing identifying details
text.ur: Mareez ki likhi razamandi, aur pehchan karwane wali tafseelat hata kar nijiyat

feedback.en: Yes — consent and anonymity are essential.
feedback.ur: Haan — razamandi aur gumnaami lazmi hain.

text.en: Nothing, if you remove only the name
text.ur: Kuch nahi, agar sirf naam hata dein

feedback.en: Dates, photos and rare details may still identify the patient.
feedback.ur: Tareekhein, tasveerein aur nadir tafseelat phir bhi pehchan karwa sakti hain.

question.en: Which of these is a good reason to write a case report?
question.ur: In mein se case report likhne ki achhi wajah kaun si hai?

text.en: To prove a new treatment is better than the old one
text.ur: Yeh sabit karne ke liye ke naya ilaaj purane se behtar hai

feedback.ur: Case bartari sabit nahi kar sakta.

text.en: To show that your clinic gets good results
text.ur: Yeh dikhane ke liye ke aap ke clinic ke nateeje achhe hain

feedback.en: One case is not a result of a clinic and may be advertising.
feedback.ur: Ek case clinic ka nateeja nahi aur ishtihaar ho sakta hai.

text.en: An unexpected adverse reaction that other clinicians should know about
text.ur: Ghair mutawaqqe adverse reaction jis ke baare mein doosre clinicians ko pata hona chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — unexpected harms and rare presentations are classic reasons.
feedback.ur: Haan — ghair mutawaqqe nuqsan aur nadir presentations aam wajuhaat hain.

text.en: **Writing a story that sounds like an advert.** A case report that only describes success, ignores negative findings and uses words such as "remarkable" or "miraculous" is not science. Include what went wrong, what you did not know, and what the patient said. Also, never publish without consent and never include a photo that could identify the patient without explicit permission.
text.ur: **Aisi kahani likhna jo ishtihaar lage.** Jo case report sirf kamyabi bayan kare, manfi findings nazar-andaaz kare aur "ghair mamooli" ya "mojizati" jaise alfaaz istemal kare woh science nahi. Jo ghalat hua, jo aap nahi jaante thay, aur jo mareez ne kaha woh shamil karein. Razamandi ke baghair kabhi shaya na karein aur wazeh ijazat ke baghair aisi tasveer shamil na karein jo mareez ki pehchan karwa sake.

text.en: **Start a case log now.** Keep a simple private note of unusual or instructive cases, with dates, findings and what you did, with identifying details removed. When you later write a case report, you will have the story, and you will be able to ask the patient for consent at the time. In Pakistan, check your institution's rules before submitting to a journal.
text.ur: **Abhi se case log shuru karein.** Ghair mamooli ya sabaq amoz cases ka saada nijji note rakhein, tareekhon, findings aur jo aap ne kiya, pehchan karwane wali tafseelat hataye hue. Jab baad mein case report likhenge to kahani aap ke paas hogi, aur aap waqt par mareez se razamandi le sakenge. Pakistan mein journal ko bhejne se pehle apne idare ke qaide dekhein.

question.en: Why do journals still publish case reports if they cannot prove anything?
question.ur: Journals phir bhi case reports kyun shaya karte hain jab woh kuch sabit nahi kar sakti?

answer.en: Case reports are the early-warning system of medicine. Many harms, such as a medicine's rare side effect, were first noticed in case reports, and many new diseases and techniques began as a single case that someone wrote up carefully. They tell the community "look here", and then larger studies can test the idea.
answer.ur: Case reports tibb ka early-warning nizam hain. Bohat se nuqsan, jaise dawai ka nadir side effect, pehle case reports mein nazar aaye, aur bohat si nayi bimariyan aur techniques ek case se shuru huin jise kisi ne ehtiyat se likha. Yeh bradari ko batati hain "yahan dekhein", aur phir bade studies khayal ko aazma sakte hain.

beats.patient: A therapist treats a 24-year-old footballer who has sudden calf pain after a flight. The calf is swollen, warm and tender, and she refers him. A scan finds a deep vein thrombosis. He recovers on medical treatment, and later returns to sport.
beats.assessment: An unusual presentation that could be mistaken for a muscle strain, with a clear learning point about red flags.
beats.treatment: She writes it using CARE: a timeline (flight, onset, visit, referral, scan, treatment), the red-flag reasoning, and the patient's own account, after getting written consent and removing identifiers.
beats.reassess: It is accepted as a teaching report, and her message is clear: any warm, swollen, tender calf after a long journey needs urgent medical assessment.

text.en: **Safety lessons are among the best reasons to write.** If you see a harm, such as a flare-up after a technique or a missed red flag, reporting it with care helps others. Never publish details that would blame the patient, and never use a case to promote a product or technique. Declare any conflict of interest.
text.ur: **Safety ke sabaq likhne ki behtareen wajuhaat mein se hain.** Agar aap koi nuqsan dekhein, jaise technique ke baad flare-up ya chhooti hui red flag, to ehtiyat se report karna doosron ki madad karta hai. Mareez ko ilzam dene wali tafseelat kabhi shaya na karein, aur case ko kisi product ya technique ki tashheer ke liye istemal na karein. Mufaadat ke takrao ka elaan karein.

text.en: The CARE guidelines were developed through a consensus process to improve the accuracy, transparency and usefulness of case reports, providing a checklist that includes a timeline, a description of the patient perspective and informed consent. The explanation and elaboration document gives examples for each item and explains why each matters, and is meant to help authors, reviewers and readers judge a case report.
text.ur: CARE guidelines ittefaq-e-raye ke amal se banai gayin taake case reports ki durusti, shaffafiyat aur mufeediat behtar ho, aur ek checklist deti hain jis mein timeline, mareez ka nuqta-e-nazar aur batayi gayi razamandi shamil hain. Explanation aur elaboration document har item ki misalein deta hai aur batata hai ke har ek kyun ahem hai, aur musannifon, reviewers aur parhne walon ko case report parkhne mein madad ke liye hai.

text.en: **Consent, Timeline, Honest, Lesson.** Get consent, build a timeline, report honestly, and state the one lesson.
text.ur: **Razamandi, Timeline, Imaandari, Sabaq.** Razamandi lein, timeline banayein, imaandari se likhein, aur ek sabaq batayein.

summary.en: A case report describes one patient in detail; it cannot prove a treatment works but can show unusual presentations, new harms and teaching points.
summary.ur: Case report ek mareez ko tafseel se bayan karti hai; yeh sabit nahi kar sakti ke ilaaj kaam karta hai lekin ghair mamooli presentations, naye nuqsan aur sabaq dikha sakti hai.

summary.en: Use CARE: a timeline, honest findings, the patient's view and a limited discussion.
summary.ur: CARE istemal karein: timeline, imaandar findings, mareez ka nuqta-e-nazar aur mehdood discussion.

summary.en: Always get written consent, remove identifying details, and avoid advertising.
summary.ur: Hamesha likhi razamandi lein, pehchan karwane wali tafseelat hata dein, aur ishtihaar se bachein.

front.ur: Case shaya karne se pehle kaun si do cheezein lazmi hain?

back.en: Written patient consent and removal of identifying details.
back.ur: Mareez ki likhi razamandi aur pehchan karwane wali tafseelat ka hatana.

front.en: Name a good reason to write a case report.
front.ur: Case report likhne ki ek achhi wajah batayein.

back.en: An unusual presentation, an unexpected harm or a teaching point.
back.ur: Ghair mamooli presentation, ghair mutawaqqe nuqsan ya sabaq.

note.en: Cases where something serious hides behind a simple complaint.
note.ur: Aise cases jahan seriyas cheez saadi shikayat ke peechay chhupti hai.
